description: This file contains an abstract test class for publisher actors in a messaging service, setting up and running various test scenarios such as message publishing, acknowledgements, and reply handling. It uses the Akka actor testing framework and mocks certain behaviors for testing actor communication in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractPublisherActorTest
classes.description: An abstract JUnit test class for testing publisher actor behavior in an Akka-based messaging service within the Eclipse Ditto project. It sets up actor systems, mocks messaging scenarios, and provides abstract methods for concrete subclasses to implement specific testing details.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the actor system before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test.

methods.name: testPublishMessage
methods.description: Tests that a message can be published through the actor.

methods.name: testPublishResponseToReplyTarget
methods.description: Tests publishing a response message to a reply target.

methods.name: createTestTarget
methods.description: Creates a test target with specified acknowledgements.

methods.name: getOutboundAddress
methods.description: Abstract: returns the outbound address used in tests.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Abstract: sets up necessary mock objects for test.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Abstract: provides Props for creating the actor under test.

methods.name: publisherCreated
methods.description: Hook method called after publisher actor creation; does nothing by default.

methods.name: decorateTarget
methods.description: Abstract: decorate or modify the target object for test purposes.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Abstract: verify that a message was published as expected.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Abstract: verify that a message was sent to the reply target.

methods.name: getMockOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates a mock outbound signal for testing, with optional extra headers.

methods.name: getMockOutboundSignalWithAutoAck
methods.description: Creates a mock outbound signal that requests auto acknowledgment.

methods.name: getResponseWithReplyTarget
methods.description: Creates a mock outbound signal that includes a reply target.
